# Cordis API

<!-- Generated by go run ./scripts/doccheck -write-api; edit Go comments. -->

本页从 Go 源码和公开注释生成。行为说明见 [生命周期](lifecycle.md)、[服务与作用域](services.md) 和 [事件](events.md)。

## Scope

Scope is an opaque service namespace. Reuse a Scope to join isolated views.
```go
type Scope struct{ token byte }
```

## NewScope

NewScope creates a unique namespace token.
```go
func NewScope() *Scope
```

## Context

Context is an immutable scope view bound to one plugin activation.
It is distinct from context.Context; GoContext carries activation cancellation.
```go
type Context struct {
	rt     *runtime
	fiber  *Fiber
	epoch  uint64
	scopes map[string]*Scope
	signal context.Context
}
```

## Option

Option customizes root construction through the supplied With functions.
```go
type Option func(*runtime)
```

## WithLogger

WithLogger sets the root logger; nil retains slog.Default.
```go
func WithLogger(logger *slog.Logger) Option
```

## New

New creates an active root container with no global registration side effects.
```go
func New(options ...Option) *Context
```

## *Context.Root

Root returns the container shared by all scopes and plugins in this tree.
```go
func (c *Context) Root() *Context
```

## *Context.Fiber

Fiber returns the plugin instance owning this activation.
```go
func (c *Context) Fiber() *Fiber
```

## *Context.GoContext

GoContext is canceled before this activation unloads.
```go
func (c *Context) GoContext() context.Context
```

## *Context.Logger

Logger returns a slog logger with the owning plugin name attached.
```go
func (c *Context) Logger() *slog.Logger
```

## *Context.Isolate

Isolate replaces only this service's namespace. Other names retain their scopes.
```go
func (c *Context) Isolate(name string, scope *Scope) *Context
```

## *Context.Plugin

Plugin validates config and registers a child. Missing dependencies leave it
Pending. A startup error returns both the failed Fiber and the error.
```go
func (c *Context) Plugin(p Plugin, config any) (*Fiber, error)
```

## *Context.Inject

Inject registers a dependency-controlled callback named "inject".
```go
func (c *Context) Inject(names []string, apply func(*Context, any) (Cleanup, error)) (*Fiber, error)
```

## *Context.Wait

Wait waits for lifecycle reconciliation, then reports current startup failures
and accumulated teardown errors. Pending plugins do not block Wait.
Do not call Wait from Apply or Cleanup: they drive the work being awaited.
```go
func (c *Context) Wait(ctx context.Context) error
```

## *Context.Refresh

Refresh re-evaluates every conditional service and reconciles the tree.
Call it after external state read by a ProvideWhen predicate changes;
consumers whose dependency became unavailable unload, and those whose
dependency returned become Pending and reactivate. It is a no-op when the
tree is already settled, so it is safe to call from any goroutine.
```go
func (c *Context) Refresh()
```

## *Context.Close

Close permanently disposes the root tree and waits for all lifecycle cleanup.
Call it from outside lifecycle callbacks. Cancellation bounds the wait only;
plugin code must cooperate with GoContext cancellation to stop its own work.
```go
func (c *Context) Close(ctx context.Context) error
```

## Snapshot

Snapshot is a stable copy suitable for diagnostics.
```go
type Snapshot struct {
	// ID identifies the plugin instance in this runtime.
	ID uint64
	// ParentID is zero when the parent is root.
	ParentID uint64
	// Name is the plugin diagnostic label.
	Name string
	// State is the lifecycle state at snapshot creation.
	State State
	// Error is the latest startup or final disposal failure.
	Error error
}
```

## *Context.Fibers

Fibers returns live registry entries in registration order, excluding root.
Disposed fibers leave the registry but remain readable through their handles.
```go
func (c *Context) Fibers() []Snapshot
```

## *Context.OnDispose

OnDispose registers a cleanup in reverse registration order. The returned
disposer is single-shot; the owner still joins manually started cleanup.
```go
func (c *Context) OnDispose(label string, cleanup Cleanup) (Cleanup, error)
```

## Event

Event contains the dispatching scope, payload and activation cancellation.
Args are shared between parallel listeners; treat them as immutable there.
```go
type Event struct {
	// Context is the dispatcher scope, not the registration scope.
	Context *Context
	// Name identifies the event being dispatched.
	Name string
	// Args contains caller-owned payloads; parallel listeners must treat them as immutable.
	Args []any
}
```

## Next

Next delegates to the rest of a waterfall chain, including its default body.
```go
type Next func() (any, error)
```

## Listener

Listener returns a bail value or error. Next is non-nil only in Waterfall.
```go
type Listener func(Event, Next) (any, error)
```

## EventOptions

EventOptions controls order, single-shot delivery and dispatch filtering.
Without Filter, events reach every registered listener in the root runtime,
including isolated scopes, matching Cordis' unfiltered dispatch behavior.
```go
type EventOptions struct {
	// Prepend places this listener before existing listeners.
	Prepend bool
	// Once claims and removes the listener before its first invocation.
	Once bool
	// Global bypasses the optional dispatcher filter.
	Global bool
}
```

## *Context.On

On registers a lifecycle-owned listener. Only loading/active contexts register.
```go
func (c *Context) On(name string, listener Listener, options EventOptions) (Cleanup, error)
```

## Dispatcher

Dispatcher selects listeners using an optional predicate on their contexts.
Global listeners bypass this predicate. The predicate runs outside the lock.
```go
type Dispatcher struct {
	ctx    *Context
	filter func(*Context) bool
}
```

## *Context.Events

Events returns a dispatcher without listener scope filtering.
```go
func (c *Context) Events() Dispatcher
```

## *Context.Filter

Filter selects listener scopes with a predicate; Global listeners bypass it.
```go
func (c *Context) Filter(predicate func(*Context) bool) Dispatcher
```

## *Context.SameScope

SameScope tests service namespace identity, for explicit event filtering.
```go
func (c *Context) SameScope(other *Context, service string) bool
```

## Dispatcher.Emit

Emit invokes listeners in order, ignores values and stops on the first error.
```go
func (d Dispatcher) Emit(name string, args ...any) error
```

## Dispatcher.Parallel

Parallel starts every listener in a goroutine and joins all errors.
```go
func (d Dispatcher) Parallel(name string, args ...any) error
```

## IsBailed

IsBailed matches Cordis: nil and false continue; 0 and "" stop the chain.
```go
func IsBailed(value any) bool
```

## Dispatcher.Serial

Serial invokes listeners sequentially until the first bail value or error.
```go
func (d Dispatcher) Serial(name string, args ...any) (any, error)
```

## Dispatcher.Bail

Bail shares Serial's synchronous Go implementation; Go has no Promise mode.
```go
func (d Dispatcher) Bail(name string, args ...any) (any, error)
```

## Dispatcher.Waterfall

Waterfall wraps a default body in listeners. Returning without calling Next
vetoes the remaining chain. A skipped stale listener delegates automatically.
```go
func (d Dispatcher) Waterfall(name string, inner Next, args ...any) (any, error)
```

## State

State identifies a plugin instance lifecycle phase.
```go
type State string
```

## Fiber

Fiber is one registered plugin instance, potentially with many activations.
```go
type Fiber struct {
	rt             *runtime
	id             uint64
	plugin         Plugin
	parent         *Context
	ctx            *Context
	state          State
	config         any
	epoch          uint64
	revision       uint64
	loadedRevision uint64
	disposed       bool
	err            error
	dependencies   []*binding
	effects        []*effect
	cancel         context.CancelFunc
}
```

## *Fiber.ID

ID is stable across restarts and unique within a root; root has ID zero.
```go
func (f *Fiber) ID() uint64
```

## *Fiber.Name

Name returns the plugin diagnostic label.
```go
func (f *Fiber) Name() string
```

## *Fiber.State

State returns a synchronized lifecycle state snapshot.
```go
func (f *Fiber) State() State
```

## *Fiber.Err

Err returns the current startup or final disposal error without waiting.
```go
func (f *Fiber) Err() error
```

## *Fiber.Wait

Wait joins root lifecycle work and includes this Fiber retained error.
Pending dependencies are settled; Wait does not wait for a provider.
```go
func (f *Fiber) Wait(ctx context.Context) error
```

## *Fiber.Dispose

Dispose permanently removes this instance and its descendants. Inside a
lifecycle callback it schedules disposal, which settles after the callback.
```go
func (f *Fiber) Dispose() error
```

## *Fiber.Update

Update validates before changing the running instance. Invalid config leaves
the current activation untouched; valid config requests a fresh activation.
```go
func (f *Fiber) Update(config any) error
```

## *Fiber.Restart

Restart requests a fresh activation with the current validated configuration.
```go
func (f *Fiber) Restart() error
```

## Cleanup

Cleanup releases a resource. All remaining cleanups run even if one fails.
```go
type Cleanup func() error
```

## Plugin

Plugin describes an entrypoint; each Plugin call creates an independent Fiber.
Config and service objects are caller-owned and must not be mutated concurrently.
```go
type Plugin struct {
	// Name labels logs and diagnostics; registrations have independent IDs.
	Name string
	// Inject lists services required before Apply runs.
	Inject []string
	// Apply acquires resources and may return a final cleanup even on failure.
	Apply func(*Context, any) (Cleanup, error)
	// Validate normalizes configuration before registration or update; nil accepts it.
	Validate func(any) (any, error)
}
```

## *Context.Provide

Provide publishes a service when its owner becomes Active. A service is
automatically removed on unload. Duplicate providers in one scope are errors.
```go
func (c *Context) Provide(name string, value any) (Cleanup, error)
```

## *Context.ProvideWhen

ProvideWhen publishes a service whose availability also depends on check.
Consumers stay Pending while check reports false and unload when it turns
false, even though the provider itself stays Active. Call Refresh after
external state read by check changes so the tree reconciles.

check runs while the runtime lock is held, so it must be a pure predicate
over the provider's own state. Calling back into Context from check
deadlocks. A nil check means the service is always available.
```go
func (c *Context) ProvideWhen(name string, value any, check func() bool) (Cleanup, error)
```

## *Context.Get

Get resolves a named service. Injected bindings remain available to the
consumer's cleanup even after the provider has begun unloading.
```go
func (c *Context) Get(name string) (any, error)
```

## Key

Key carries the consumer's expected service type. Use interface types to
depend on small capabilities rather than concrete provider implementations.
```go
type Key[T any] struct{ name string }
```

## NewKey

NewKey creates a typed lookup key; service names are shared across key types.
```go
func NewKey[T any](name string) Key[T]
```

## Key[T].Name

Name exposes the key name for dependency declarations and isolation.
```go
func (k Key[T]) Name() string
```

## Provide

Provide registers a typed service with Context.Provide ownership rules.
```go
func Provide[T any](c *Context, key Key[T], value T) (Cleanup, error)
```

## Resolve

Resolve returns the expected type or ErrServiceType, and the zero value on failure.
Use interface keys to permit interchangeable providers.
```go
func Resolve[T any](c *Context, key Key[T]) (T, error)
```

## 状态与错误

生命周期状态：`Pending`、`Loading`、`Active`、`Failed`、`Unloading`、`Disposed`。可用 `errors.Is` 判断 `ErrInactive`、`ErrDuplicateService`、`ErrServiceNotFound`、`ErrServiceType`。定义见 [fiber.go](../../cordis/fiber.go) 和 [plugin.go](../../cordis/plugin.go)。
